TEACHING COMPLETENESS MATRIX — PER USE CASE
UCs A, B, C_nlp, C_markets, E — same 4-key
Scope: ~250 lines per UC × 5 UCs in app.py
New use case: Kaggle Telco/Bank Churn.
Scope: 6 scripts + SEC EDGAR data pipeline
step health. 5-cell row per use case:
Add a "📈 Data Profiling" page to dashboard/app.py. For each column: histogram + KDE overlay, box-and-whisker
with outlier dots, skewness/kurtosis/entropy badges, % missing bar. Add pairwise scatter matrix (top-10 numeric
by variance) and a dataset health scorecard (completeness %, duplicate %, type-consistency %, cardinality flags).
Add a "🧹 Data Cleansing" page. For each column with issues: show before/after distribution toggle, imputation
strategy dropdown (mean/median/mode/KNN/flag-and-drop), outlier method selector (IQR/Z-score/IF). Show a
live data-quality diff table. Concept cards explain MCAR/MAR/MNAR and leakage risk. Export cleaned parquet.
Extend the FE page: feature importance live preview (retrain fast LR after each toggle), VIF multicollinearity
table, interaction term builder, encoding strategy comparison (OHE vs target vs frequency encoding), and a
feature selection leaderboard with macro-F1 delta per feature added or removed.
Add an animated fold-by-fold CV visualiser: show train/val split per fold as coloured strips, per-fold metric
distribution boxplot, learning curves (train vs val score vs training size), bias-variance decomposition
diagram, and overfitting detector flag when train–val gap exceeds configurable threshold.
Side-by-side model comparison table with sortable metrics, radar chart overlay, ROC/PR curves on one canvas,
DET curve, calibration curves, and McNemar's test for statistical significance of performance differences.
"Why this model?" concept cards for each algorithm with complexity trade-offs.
Load lgbm_optuna_trials.csv. Render: parallel coordinates (Plotly), 2-param contour heatmap (select x/y from
dropdowns), fANOVA importance bar chart, convergence curve (trial # vs best score). Slider panel replays
any trial config and scores it on val set without retraining.
Add a "⚖️ Fairness" page. Protected-attribute selector from val_fe.parquet columns. Compute and display:
demographic parity ratio, equalised odds (TPR/FPR per group), calibration curves per group, disparate impact.
Flag EU AI Act risk tier. Surface mitigation options: threshold shift per group, reweighting, fairness-aware retraining.
Sidebar toggle "Teaching Mode". When ON: every Plotly chart gains an ℹ️ expander with concept card (plain
explanation + citation + what-to-look-for). Guided walkthrough sequences cards into a lesson with progress
tracker and completion badges per use case. _EDA_INSIGHTS + stage_notes drive the content per UC.
One-click model card export (PDF + docx + JSON). Sections: dataset, preprocessing, CV results, champion spec,
fairness audit, SHAP top-10, business impact. EU AI Act Annex IV template. Triggered from Model Evaluation
page "Export Model Card" button. Uses python-docx + fpdf2 + json.dumps.
